situation (example wording): A monthly rate for one place ("murder rate per month in Dallas"); several places by month ("Nashville vs New Orleans murders per month")
what the app does today: "Each month's own count, not scaled to a full year." under the title; the several-place table's first column headed "Agency".
proposed behavior: A rate by month needs no note saying what a rate is: the line "Each month's own count, not scaled to a full year." is removed from the monthly rate of one place (Current Trends and NIBRS). The NIBRS note naming the population each month's rate uses stays. The first column of a monthly table of several places is headed "Place".
exact default or choices offered: The title, then only the exceptions, then the Source line.
why: Jeff 2026-11-18 (through the coordinator): "a rate is self explanatory"; "Place" instead of "Agency".
